name: Weather station
description: Live readings from your own weather station, which uploads to kinframe: temperature, wind, rain, pressure and sunlight.

settings.label: Station ID
settings.help: The ID your station uploads with: its Weather Underground station ID, or the one you set in its custom server settings.

settings.label: Station key
settings.help: The key (password) your station uploads with: its Weather Underground station key.

settings.label: Pass the uploads on to Weather Underground
Public page
settings.help: The station's readings and the last 48 hours as charts, for anyone, at kinframe.appmire.be/station/<station ID> and in the list of public stations at kinframe.appmire.be/stations. Nothing about your frame or its place is shown.

settings.label: Title of the public page
settings.help: For example the village or street the station is in. Empty: only the station ID.
